q1_differentScenesDifferentRankings.answer: Mean pairwise top16 Jaccard across all 28 scene pairs = 0.02 (range 0-0.19). Rankings differ substantially across scenes.

q2_oppositeScenesShareTooManyTracks.answer: Overlap counts for the four requested opposite pairs (see namedOppositePairs) are reported without an imposed pass/fail threshold, per instructions.

q3_oneTrackDominatesManyScenes.answer: 0 track(s) appear in all 8 scenes; 0 track(s) appear in at least 4 of 8 scenes; 16 track(s) appear in more than 1 scene.

q4_oneArtistDominatesManyScenes.answer: Maximum scene-recurrence for a single artist across the 8 scene top-16 sets = 3 of 8 scenes (0 artist(s) recur in >=4 scenes).

q5_onePrimaryGenreDominatesMostScenes.answer: "pop" is the per-scene modal primaryGenre in 2 of 8 scenes (bright-warm-summer-day, dreamy-hazy-dusk) -> classified as "scene-specific concentration".

q6_oneSubgenreDominatesMostScenes.answer: "dream-pop" is the per-scene modal subgenre in 2 of 8 scenes (rainy-intimate-late-night, cold-open-winter-space) -> classified as "scene-specific concentration".

q7_seasonMateriallyAffectsRanking.answer: A: same targetStats, summer vs winter affinity: top16 overlap 6/16, top10 overlap 4/10, rank-order correlation -0.28, mean score change -1.01.

q8_timeMateriallyAffectsRanking.answer: B: same targetStats, morning vs lateNight affinity: top16 overlap 10/16, top10 overlap 5/10, rank-order correlation -0.06, mean score change 0.22.

q9_weatherMateriallyAffectsRanking.answer: C: same targetStats, clear vs rain affinity: top16 overlap 7/16, top10 overlap 5/10, rank-order correlation -0.28, mean score change -0.35.

q10_desiredSoundMateriallyAffectsRanking.answer: Energy check (D): 3/16 overlap, mean score change 0.5. Acoustic/electronic check (E): 3/16 overlap, mean score change -1.06.

checkD.answer: D: same contextAffinity, low vs high energy targetStats: top16 overlap 3/16, top10 overlap 3/10, rank-order correlation -0.35, mean score change 0.5.

checkE.answer: E: same contextAffinity, low-acoustic/high-electronic vs high-acoustic/low-electronic targetStats: top16 overlap 3/16, top10 overlap 2/10, rank-order correlation -0.5, mean score change -1.06.

q11_scoreSpreadWideEnough.answer: Mean top16 scoreSpread (topScore - rank16Score) across the 8 scenes = 3.19 points.

q12_ranks11to16WeakerThan1to10.answer: Mean (rank1-10 avg minus rank11-16 avg) totalScore gap across the 8 scenes = 1.26 points.

q15_vectorSimilarityRedundancyEvidence.answer: Genre-label overlap and actual 30-dim track-vector similarity are measured separately. Mean pairwise track-to-track vector similarity within top-16 sets (production scoreCatalogTrack formula, applied track-vs-track) averages 88.72/100 across the 8 scenes. This is independent of whether tracks share a genre label — see vectorRedundancy per scene for detail.
q15_vectorSimilarityRedundancyEvidence.note: genre label identity is NOT used as a proxy for this metric; it is computed purely from stats/affinity vectors via the real scoring formula.

q16_weightsOrStatsCalibrationEvidence.answer: Component means vary across scenes (see perSceneResults[].componentInfluence), and total-score spreads/tier-gaps are nonzero and vary by scene concept — this diagnostic alone does not establish a calibration defect; it only documents the current distribution for future comparison.
